design.new_input: The print affirmatively gives common elemental mixture to every human while denying that every thing is wholesome for everyone. These are distinct quantifier-scope consequences, not four category labels or a change to qo negation.
design.source_scope: The minimum regimen proposition modeled here is NOT(for every person and every candidate treatment, that treatment benefits that person). The source's more specific constitution-dependent rules are not thereby supplied. Calling its broad 'things' a domain of candidate treatments is an explicit narrowing, not a diplomatic translation.

exact_grammar: QuantifiedTerm may be 'Domain or' or 'or Domain'. These are TWO openly stipulated placement licenses with exactly the same ALL denotation; no automatic universal dual word order.
Membership frame: [Domain or] [or Domain] Relation; Relation is the typed binary predicate over the two domains, yielding forall x in first-domain forall y in second-domain R(x,y).
Regimen frame: [or Domain] Relation [or Domain] olchey; olchey negates the ENTIRE universally quantified proposition. No universal is silently canceled or changed to existential.
The frames create Proposition terms. They do not license silently discarding remaining tokens or inserting a sentence boundary.

actual_derivations.locus: N.2, exact in all three readers
actual_derivations.formula: forall e in Elements forall p in Persons IS_COMPONENT_OF(e,p)
actual_derivations.consequence: Every named element belongs to every person; this does not say one person equals an element or possesses only one.

actual_derivations.surface: or aiin ckhed[a:y] or ain olchey
actual_derivations.formula: NOT(forall p in Persons forall t in Treatments IS_BENEFITED_BY(p,t))
actual_derivations.consequence: At least one person/treatment combination fails universal benefit, assuming nonempty domains; it does not say every combination is harmful or every person has an unsuitable treatment.

scope_rivals.name: Negation inside both universal scopes
scope_rivals.formula: forall p forall t NOT BENEFIT(p,t)
scope_rivals.difference: Says no candidate treatment benefits any person; much stronger than the chosen minimum.

scope_rivals.name: Person-specific nonuniversality
scope_rivals.difference: Every person has at least one unsuitable treatment; stronger than the chosen global failure, without denying all benefit.
